instruction: Design a college student dashboard for tracking attendance with features like real-time updates, notifications, and progress charts.
input: The dashboard should include features for logging in, viewing attendance records, receiving push notifications for missed classes, and generating weekly progress reports.
output: Design Solution: The dashboard will have a clean and modern interface with a login/signup section, a main dashboard with a calendar view of classes and attendance status, real-time updates for class status changes, a notifications section for missed class alerts, and a progress chart showing attendance over time. Users can also generate weekly progress reports and export them as PDFs. The design will be responsive and accessible, ensuring a seamless experience on both desktop and mobile devices.

instruction: Design a student profile page that displays academic performance information in a clear and organized manner.
input: The page should include sections for displaying the student's grades, test scores, and academic achievements. It should also allow for the addition and removal of academic performance data.
output:
Design Solution for Student Profile Page with Academic Performance

1. Header Section: A title 'Student Profile' at the top of the page with a user icon/avatar for navigation.

2. Academic Performance Section: This section will display the student's academic performance data. It will include a table with columns for 'Subject', 'Grade', 'Test Score', and 'Achievement'. The table will be sortable by subject and grade.

3. Add/Edit Academic Performance Section: This section will allow the user to add or edit academic performance data. It will include fields for 'Subject', 'Grade', 'Test Score', and 'Achievement'. The user can also delete entries from this section.

4. Footer Section: A section for displaying any additional information or links related to academic performance, such as a link to a grading rubric or a link to a resource for students to improve their grades.

5. Navigation Bar: A navigation bar at the top of the page with links to other sections of the student profile page, such as 'Personal Information', 'Courses', and 'Academic Performance'.

6. Responsive Design: The page should be designed to be responsive, ensuring that it is easy to use on both desktop and mobile devices.

instruction: Design a faculty dashboard for managing student records with specific functionalities.
input: The dashboard should allow faculty members to view, edit, and manage student records. It should include features for adding new students, updating student information, and deleting student records. The dashboard should also display a list of all students with their basic information.
output:
The faculty dashboard should have the following design elements and functionalities:

1. Navigation Bar: Contains links to different sections of the dashboard such as Home, Add Student, Edit Student, Delete Student, and View Students.

2. Home Section: Displays a summary of the dashboard, including the number of students managed, the number of new students added, and the number of students deleted.

3. Add Student Section: Allows faculty members to add new student records. This section should include fields for entering student details such as name, ID, email, and contact information.

4. Edit Student Section: Allows faculty members to update existing student records. This section should include fields for updating student details such as name, ID, email, and contact information.

5. Delete Student Section: Allows faculty members to remove student records. This section should include a confirmation message before deletion.

6. View Students Section: Displays a list of all students with their basic information. The list should be sortable by name, ID, and date of birth. The section should also include a search bar to filter students by name or ID.

7. User Interface: The dashboard should have a clean and user-friendly interface with appropriate colors, fonts, and icons. The layout should be responsive and compatible with different screen sizes.

instruction: Design a college notice board and announcements page with specific components and functionalities.

instruction: Design a hostel room allocation management interface
input: The interface should allow administrators to manage room allocations, including adding, updating, and deleting room assignments. Users should be able to search for rooms by name, and the interface should be responsive for both desktop and mobile devices. The design should prioritize accessibility, with clear labels and sufficient color contrast.
output: The hostel room allocation management interface design solution is as follows: The interface will be divided into three main sections: a navigation bar, a main content area, and a footer. The navigation bar will include links to different sections such as Room List, Add Room, Update Room, Delete Room, and Search Room. The main content area will display a table with room details, including room name, room number, and room status. Users can click on the room name to view the room details or make changes. The footer will contain links to support and logout. The interface will be responsive, with a layout optimized for both desktop and mobile devices. The color scheme will use a light blue for background and dark blue for text for contrast. The interface will also include keyboard navigation support for users who prefer to use a keyboard. The search functionality will allow users to filter room names by entering a keyword. The interface will be accessible, with clear labels for all elements and sufficient color contrast between text and background colors. The interface will be designed to be user-friendly and intuitive for administrators managing hostel room allocations.

instruction: Design a faculty attendance reporting dashboard for a university's administrative system.
input: The dashboard should provide real-time updates on faculty attendance, including a weekly summary and monthly totals. It should also allow for exporting data to Excel and generating PDF reports. The design should be intuitive and user-friendly, with clear labels and colors to differentiate between different types of data (e.g., green for attendance, red for absence). The layout should be responsive for both desktop and mobile devices, with a clean and modern aesthetic. The dashboard should be accessible to users with disabilities, including those who use screen readers.
output: The dashboard will have the following components and features: a navigation bar, a main content area, and a footer. The navigation bar will include links to different sections of the dashboard, such as 'Weekly Attendance Report', 'Monthly Attendance Report', 'Export Data', and 'Generate PDF'. The main content area will display real-time data, weekly summaries, and monthly totals. Data will be presented in a table format, with each row representing a different faculty member and each column representing a different day of the week. The table will have a header row with column titles and a footer row with summary statistics for each week and month. Each cell in the table will display a color-coded icon to indicate whether a faculty member was present (green), absent (red), or late (yellow). The user can hover over the cell to see the specific date and time of the attendance record. The footer will include links to additional resources and a feedback form. The design will use a modern and clean color scheme, with a primary color of #007BFF and a secondary color of #6C757D. The dashboard will be responsive and will adjust its layout based on the screen size. It will be accessible to users with disabilities, with ARIA labels for all interactive elements and alt text for images. The dashboard will be tested with users with disabilities to ensure accessibility and usability.
